description: Transcribe a public direct audio file URL (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg/opus, flac; max 25 MB and 10 minutes, checked from the file header before transcription) with Whisper (@cf/openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo) on Cloudflare Workers AI. Returns text, language, duration, segments with timestamps, optional SRT/VTT subtitles. YouTube/TikTok/Instagram and other page URLs are rejected. Failed transcriptions and files with no detected speech are not charged. Costs $0.01 USDC per file via x402.

include_words.description: Include word-level timestamps in segments (default false)

language.description: Optional ISO language hint, e.g. en, ur, es (auto-detected if omitted)

subtitles.description: Also return SRT and/or WebVTT subtitles (default none)

url.description: Direct public URL of an audio file

name: transcribe_audio
